Woodson, a renowned scholar and journalist in 1926 and gradually expanded to a month-long observation and whereas the 2025 theme quote african americans and labor quote focuses on the various and profound ways that work of all kinds free and enslaved skilled and unskilled vocational and technical intersect with the collective experiences of black people and sets out to highlight and celebrate the potent impact of

of this work to the United States and across the globe; and whereas the first Africans arrived on the shores of Virginia 400 years ago, bringing skills, knowledge, and traditions that have created a lasting culture impacting our communities that continue to be reflected in daily life; and whereas the contributions of African Americans to the labor force include Richard Spikes, an inventor with more than a dozen patents, including the automatic gear shift, the automatic safety brake system, an automatic car washer and automatic directional signals, Alexander Miles who invented an elevator that was able to open and close its own doors
